key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29462
name: update_entity_motion_vectors
description: If any of three stored 16-bit motion components is nonzero, it calls unnamed routines, adds the results into three accumulator pairs with carry propagation, and clears several status and offset fields. Otherwise it scales three stored vector components by a computed shift count, adjusts them with a further value, and stores them as result fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29490
name: accumulate_offsets_and_reset_state
description: Copies one flag-selected byte from the second structure into the first, then adds a value returned by an unnamed routine into three accumulator pairs with carry propagation. It finishes by clearing several status and offset fields and returning zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2950E
name: store_scaled_negative_offsets
description: Multiplies three signed 16-bit components by a 32-bit scale, using absolute values and reapplying each sign to its product. It stores each negated offset minus its product into three result fields, then calls an unnamed routine and shifts the returned value by a count clamped to four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29572
name: scale_components_into_deltas
description: Multiplies three 16-bit values read from the structure by a 32-bit scale, applying the scale's sign to each product. It stores each product minus the matching stored offset into three result fields, then calls an unnamed routine and shifts the returned value by a count clamped to four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29602
name: normalize_vector_then_transform
description: Right-shifts three signed input components until each magnitude fits within 14 bits, then computes two outputs as dot products with entries of a stored 3x3 table. Each output is doubled and its high 16 bits are returned as a packed pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2964A
name: multiply_vector_by_matrix
description: Computes two outputs as sums of three products between the input components and two sets of three stored table entries. Each sum is doubled and its high 16 bits are returned as a packed pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2969E
name: clamp_components_to_limits
description: Clamps three signed 16-bit values to the minimum and maximum limits stored for each component. It writes the clamped results into three adjacent result fields in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:296B0
name: floor_and_clamp_components
description: Raises the first input to at least a value supplied in a register, clamps the second and third inputs between stored lower and upper limits, and writes the three results into the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:296BA
name: clamp_second_and_third_components
description: Writes the first input unchanged, clamps the second and third inputs between stored lower and upper limits, and stores all three values in consecutive structure fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:296CC
name: floor_second_and_clamp_third
description: Writes the first input unchanged, raises the second input to at least a supplied minimum, and clamps the third input between stored limits before storing all three.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:296D6
name: clamp_third_component_and_store
description: Writes the first two inputs unchanged and clamps the third input between stored lower and upper limits before storing it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:296E8
name: floor_third_component_and_store
description: Writes the first two inputs unchanged and raises the third input to at least a supplied minimum before storing it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:296F2
name: store_three_components_directly
description: Writes three 16-bit input values into consecutive fields of the structure without clamping or other changes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:296FA
name: accumulate_weighted_matrix_product
description: Normalizes an input value into a shift count and a scaled 16-bit value, then forms three sums across a stored 3x3 table weighted by three stored factors, skipping zero factors. The doubled sums are added into three 32-bit accumulators, shifted by the count when it is non-negative, and otherwise added as split 16-bit pieces with carries.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:297CC
name: accumulate_clamped_weighted_matrix
description: Forms three weighted sums from a stored 3x3 table and adds them into three accumulators. A non-negative shift count clamps each sum to limits held in the structure and skips the update on signed overflow, while the other cases add split 16-bit pieces with carries and use an extra check for larger magnitudes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:298A6
name: add_clamped_increments_checked
description: Adds two 16-bit increments into stored words and writes three 32-bit fields, each a bounded input plus a supplied offset. Each write is skipped when a signed overflow would result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:298C0
name: set_clamped_offsets_with_increment
description: Adds a 16-bit increment into a stored word, then writes one 32-bit field directly from a supplied value and two others as bounded inputs plus offsets. Those two writes are skipped when a signed overflow would result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:298DA
name: clamp_and_add_value
description: Raises one input to at least a supplied floor, adds a supplied offset to it, and stores the sum with two other supplied values in the structure. The stores are skipped when a signed overflow would result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:298EC
name: shift_clamp_and_accumulate_offsets
description: Right-shifts three input components by a supplied count and clamps each one to a limit stored in the structure. It adds the three results into stored 32-bit accumulators and updates them only when no signed overflow results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29902
name: clamp_offsets_and_accumulate
description: Clamps three input values to bounds supplied in registers and adds them to three stored 32-bit accumulators. The accumulators are updated only when no signed overflow results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2990E
name: clamp_two_inputs_and_accumulate
description: Clamps two input values to bounds supplied in registers, then adds a supplied value and the two clamped values into three stored 32-bit accumulators. Each addition is skipped when a signed overflow would result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2991A
name: accumulate_offset_with_two_clamps
description: Adds a supplied value directly into the first stored accumulator and adds two other inputs, each limited by a register value, into the second and third accumulators. The update is skipped when a signed overflow would result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29926
name: accumulate_offsets_clamping_third
description: Adds two supplied values directly into the first two accumulators and adds a third value, limited by a register bound, into the third. The update is skipped when a signed overflow would result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29932
name: accumulate_offsets_raising_third
description: Adds two supplied values directly into the first two accumulators and adds a third value raised to at least a register bound into the third. The update is skipped when a signed overflow would result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2993E
name: accumulate_three_offsets_checked
description: Adds three supplied values into the three stored 32-bit accumulators. The whole update is skipped when any of the three additions would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2995A
name: normalize_and_rescale_offsets
description: Returns zero immediately when a flag byte in the structure is clear. Otherwise it shifts three accumulated 32-bit components down into a 14-bit range and, when a field of a second structure is nonzero, rescales them with a division-derived factor before adding them into stored offset fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:299C0
name: scale_inputs_and_accumulate_offsets
description: Shifts three input components right by a count that brings a 32-bit magnitude into a 14-bit range, storing them in scratch fields. When a field of the second structure is nonzero, it derives a division-based factor and adds the scaled components into stored 16-bit and 32-bit offset fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29A6C
name: scale_components_with_shift_accumulate
description: Normalizes a 32-bit scale value to 15 bits, multiplies three input components by it, and shifts each product by a count derived from an exponent. Depending on the sign of that count, the products are added into three 32-bit offset fields directly or also update separate 16-bit low-part words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29AC8
name: shift_and_accumulate_offsets
description: Right-shifts three input values by a supplied exponent plus sixteen when that count is non-negative, then adds them into three 32-bit offset fields. The values are added unshifted when the count is negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29AE8
name: add_second_state_into_first
description: Copies the flag byte from the second structure and adds its three accumulator pairs into the first with carry propagation. It then adds an unnamed routine's 64-bit result and a sum of the third accumulators from both structures into stored offset fields, and calls a further unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29B2A
name: accumulate_state_with_offsets
description: Copies the flag byte from the second structure and adds its three accumulator pairs into the first with carry propagation. It then adds an unnamed routine's 64-bit result and a sum of the third accumulators from both structures into stored offset fields, and calls a further unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29B7A
name: add_second_state_then_offsets
description: Calls an unnamed routine first, then copies the flag byte from the second structure and adds its accumulator pairs into the first with carry propagation. It finishes by adding an unnamed routine's result and a sum of the third accumulators into stored offset fields and calling a further unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29B82
name: subtract_entity_position
description: Copies a byte from a register into the structure, then calls an unnamed routine before subtracting the second structure's accumulator pairs from the first with borrow propagation. It then subtracts an unnamed routine's result and a difference of the third accumulators from stored offset fields and calls a further unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29C0C
name: select_lowest_cost_table_entry
description: Scans a flagged table downward and scores each candidate by a weighted difference from a per-entry 16-bit field, keeping the lowest score. It then sets the structure's flag byte and updates its accumulators to the chosen entry, or returns early if that entry is already selected.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29C3E
name: update_to_nearest_flagged_candidate
description: Returns early when a status byte in the structure is set; otherwise it scans a flagged table for the candidate with the lowest weighted cost. When the winning candidate differs from the current flag, it updates the flag and the accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29C44
name: find_best_flagged_table_entry
description: Scans a flagged table downward for entries whose flag matches a supplied byte and keeps the one with the lowest weighted cost. It then sets the structure's flag and updates its accumulators to that entry, or returns when the flag is already current.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29C52
name: clear_flag_and_scan_table
description: Clears one bit of a global status byte and, if that bit was previously clear, scans a table backward. For each entry with a specific flag bit set, it calls an unnamed routine, zeroes a byte in the entry's structure, and sets a 32-bit field to a pair of sentinel values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29C84
name: select_and_forward_four_words
description: Reads four 16-bit words from one of two blocks in the structure, using the second block after an unnamed routine call when a flag byte is set. It then passes the four words to another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29C9C
name: copy_transform_into_buffer
description: Copies a nine-word block from the structure into a buffer, then zeroes two longword fields and sets two more fields to constants. It makes unnamed routine calls before and after the copy.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29CD6
name: transform_vector_by_object_matrix
description: Multiplies the object's stored 3x3 matrix by a three-component vector and writes the three products into a global result block. When a flag in the object is set, it repeats the transform with a second matrix stored in the object and writes a second result block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29DBC
name: normalize_relative_position_offset
description: Subtracts a stored position from a supplied position and normalizes the three resulting components by shifting them right to reduce their magnitude. It then stores them along with four longwords selected from a table by the low three bits of a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29DC4
name: normalize_offset_after_chain_walk
description: Walks a sequence of structures, each found by an unnamed routine, until one has a flag bit set. It then subtracts that structure's stored position from a supplied position, normalizes the three differences by shifting them right, and stores them with four longwords selected from a table by the low three bits of a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29E64
name: load_table_into_buffer
description: Stores three supplied 16-bit values into a buffer and copies four longwords from a table into fixed buffer fields. The table entry is selected by the low three bits of a status byte in a second structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29F04
name: process_flagged_object_entries
description: Sets a status bit in a global byte, then walks a table backward for entries with a specific bit set. For each such entry whose counter byte is zero, it stores a word and clears status bits, then writes a pair of sentinel values if the entry's identifier matches a global value and otherwise calls an unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:29FF2
name: walk_flagged_entries_backward
description: Walks a table backward for entries with a specific bit set. Entries whose identifier matches a global value get a pair of sentinel values written, and the others are passed to an unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A018
name: write_sentinel_then_process_flagged
description: Writes a pair of sentinel values into the current entry, then walks a table backward for entries with a specific bit set. Those whose identifier matches a global value receive the sentinel pair again, and the others are passed to an unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A022
name: service_flagged_entries_with_counters
description: Walks a table backward for entries with a specific bit set and calls an unnamed routine for each. A counter byte is decremented when nonzero; when it is zero, a stored word is set and another unnamed routine is called.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A050
name: process_object_flags
description: Stores a supplied word into a global field and walks a table backward for entries with a specific bit set. For each flagged entry an unnamed routine is called, and a counter byte is decremented when nonzero; when the counter is zero, the stored word is rewritten and the sequence restarts.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A06C
name: accumulate_table_selected_motion
description: Selects a pair of table values by a status byte and a global flag, negating the stored matrix rows on one branch, and forms three dot products. The products are shifted right by twelve bits and added with carry into three accumulators, and a state field is set to a constant.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A0A4
name: accumulate_indexed_table_motion
description: Selects one of two table value pairs by an index and a global flag, negating the stored matrix rows on one branch, and forms three dot products. The products are shifted right by twelve bits and added with carry into three accumulators, and a state field is set to a constant.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A156
name: accumulate_indexed_table_dot_products
description: Selects a table value pair by an index and a global flag, then forms three dot products with stored matrix rows. The products are shifted right by twelve bits, added with carry into three accumulators, and a state field is set to a constant.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A1CE
name: clear_entry_counter_byte
description: Writes zero into a counter byte of the entry structure and does nothing else.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A1D4
name: reset_countdown_and_visit_entries
description: Resets a countdown word to zero and walks a table backward for nonzero entries. Entries without a specific bit set are passed to two unnamed routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A1DC
name: iterate_and_call_handler
description: Walks a byte table backward and, for each nonzero entry whose bit five is clear, calls an unnamed routine and then a function pointer held in a register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A200
name: check_bounds_and_call
description: Walks a flagged table backward and, for each qualifying entry, calls an unnamed routine and checks two word fields against fixed ranges. The stored function pointer is called only when both fields are in range.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A240
name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Walks a table backward for entries whose lowest bit is set and calls an unnamed routine for each. A counter byte is decremented when nonzero; when it is already zero, it is reloaded from a second field and a handler chosen by an index byte is called.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A290
name: dispatch_flagged_entries_by_index
description: Clears the second-lowest bit of a global flag byte and walks a table backward for entries with that bit set. For each, an unnamed routine is called and, when an index byte in the entry is nonzero, a handler from a pointer table is invoked.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A2D2
name: write_byte_to_indirect
description: Stores the low byte of a register at an offset taken from a byte field of the entry, relative to a global base pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A2E6
name: find_and_fill_flagged_slot
description: Finds the highest-indexed table entry with a specific bit set and, when that index is nonzero, writes a flag byte there and adjusts a global counter. It then copies a large input structure into that entry's record and fills extra fields when a value is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A306
name: find_and_fill_clear_slot
description: Finds the highest-indexed table entry with a specific bit clear and returns early when none is found. Otherwise it writes a flag byte and adjusts a global counter, copies a large input structure into that entry's record, and fills extra fields when a value is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A32E
name: store_flag_and_copy_record
description: Stores a flag byte at a supplied table index and adjusts a global counter when that index is nonzero. It then copies a large input structure into the matching table record and, when a second index is nonzero, fills extra fields using two values derived from a table entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A33A
name: copy_record_and_fill_fields
description: Copies a large structure from the input into a second structure when the two addresses differ. It then fills fields from a table entry chosen by an index, including a flag byte and, when a table offset is nonzero, values read from that table data, and sets a byte field to all ones.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A4FC
name: find_slot_and_copy_record
description: Searches the table backward for a zero byte at a usable index, falling back to an entry with a specific bit clear, and returns early when neither is found. It then writes a flag byte, updates a global counter, copies a large input structure into the chosen record, and fills extra fields when a value is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A51C
name: claim_slot_and_copy_record
description: Searches the table backward for a zero byte, falling back to an entry with a specific bit set, and returns early when neither is usable. It then writes a flag byte, adjusts a global counter, copies a large input structure into the chosen record, and fills extra fields when a value is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A552
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work, so it is an empty stub.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work, so it is an empty stub.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A66C
name: clear_buffer_from_pointer
description: Stores a supplied buffer pointer in a global field and zeroes a fixed run of 115 bytes starting at that pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A67E
name: clear_flagged_table_entries
description: Resets a global counter word to zero and walks a table backward, zeroing each entry whose bit five is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A6A0
name: clear_entry_and_decrement
description: Reads an index byte from the entry and, when the table byte at that index has bit five set, decrements a global counter. It then clears that table byte to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A6C4
name: forward_control_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to an unnamed routine and returns, forwarding nothing else.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A6CE
name: notify_flagged_slots_and_clear
description: If the table byte for the entry has bit five clear, it calls a function pointer at a fixed offset in each record whose flag bit is set, then zeroes that byte. Otherwise it decrements a global counter and zeroes the byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A71A
name: update_countdown_and_dispatch_state
description: Calls a method on each flagged record, then either forwards the request through an unnamed routine when a table flag or lookup value is zero, or subtracts a supplied value from a countdown word. When that word underflows, it moves the overflow into a second word and updates several status fields, looking up further table values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A7D8
name: call_function_pointer
description: Calls a function pointer stored at a fixed offset in a global table, then returns a 64-bit value with the constant one in the high half and the input register in the low half.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A7F0
name: call_and_set_entry_flag
description: Calls a function pointer from a global table and sets the lowest bit of a status byte in the entry. When a state byte equals minus one, it calls a second function pointer, and it returns the constant one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A80A
name: process_object_state
description: Updates a global accumulator from a table entry chosen by an index, invoking a callback when its high half changes, and resets several state fields in the record. It then adjusts a counter field and runs callbacks in loops driven by table values, returning zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A9A4
name: return_stack_parameter
description: Returns the 32-bit value passed on the stack without other changes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2A9AA
name: initialize_record_and_accumulate
description: Makes several unnamed calls to set up a record, storing a 16-bit value and setting several state bytes to fixed values. It adds shifted values from two lookups into three accumulators and returns the result of a final call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AA14
name: classify_value_and_adjust_counters
description: Fetches a value and, when a record field equals minus one and the value is below a global limit, scans a thirty-entry table to increment a counter. Otherwise it classifies the value into ranges that adjust three global counters from a lookup table or clear per-record fields, then calls unnamed routines and returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AA64
name: extract_flag_from_mask
description: Calls an unnamed routine for an index until the bit at that index is set in a 32-bit mask. It then moves that bit from the mask into a second 32-bit field and clears it in the mask.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AAB6
name: adjust_counters_by_value_range
description: Classifies an input value into three ranges. Lower ranges adjust global counters from a lookup table, the top range clears per-record fields, and unnamed routines finish the update before it returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AAF0
name: consume_stored_value_and_adjust
description: Reads and clears a stored byte and a longword in the record, then adds a lookup value for that byte to three global counters when the record field is set. Unnamed routines finish the update and it returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AB24
name: mark_stored_value_and_adjust
description: If the stored byte is nonzero, it sets that byte to one and, when the record field is set, adds a lookup value minus four to three global counters. Unnamed routines finish the update and it returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AB5A
name: find_value_bucket_and_count
description: When a value is below a global limit, it subtracts thirty table entries from it until the result goes negative, then increments the bucket counter reached and a global total. Unnamed routines finish the update and it returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AB8E
name: advance_timers_and_return_amount
description: Advances per-record timers and status counters by a supplied step, and computes a scaled amount from the record's absolute vector components. It subtracts that amount from a 32-bit accumulator and returns it, or when the accumulator is exhausted, resets it, may invoke an unnamed routine, clears three stored 32-bit fields, and then returns the amount.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AC78
name: subtract_accumulator_and_reset_fields
description: Subtracts a supplied amount from a 32-bit accumulator and returns while it stays positive. Once it runs out, it zeroes the accumulator and either adjusts global counters and calls an unnamed routine for matching records, or decrements a secondary counter, then clears three stored 32-bit fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2ACB2
name: spend_counter_or_reset_fields
description: If a global counter is nonzero, it decrements that counter, increments a second one, adds a fixed increment to the accumulator and returns. Otherwise it sets a status flag, calls an unnamed routine when the flag was previously clear, and clears three stored 32-bit fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2ACC2
name: decrement_secondary_counter_or_clear
description: Decrements a secondary counter and adds a fixed increment to the accumulator when that counter is nonzero. Otherwise it clears three stored 32-bit fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2ACDA
name: set_flag_and_call_handler
description: Sets the lowest bit of a global status byte and, if that bit was previously clear, calls a function pointer from a table. It then clears three stored 32-bit fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AD0C
name: decrement_timer_and_dispatch_event
description: Subtracts a supplied step from a 32-bit timer and returns while it stays positive. When it wraps, it reloads the timer, decrements two 16-bit counters, and runs a comparison that may apply a pending record value to three global counters before calling a function pointer from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AD14
name: reload_timer_and_dispatch_event
description: Reloads a 32-bit timer by a fixed increment and decrements two 16-bit counters. It then runs a comparison that may apply a pending record value to three global counters and calls a function pointer from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AD4C
name: apply_pending_record_value
description: When a record byte is nonzero, it clears that byte and the record's accumulator, adds a lookup value to three global counters, and calls a function pointer from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AD80
name: apply_pending_value_above_limit
description: Calls an unnamed routine and, when its low byte exceeds a global limit, applies the record's pending value to three global counters and calls a function pointer from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:2AD86
name: apply_pending_value_after_check
description: Calls an unnamed routine and, when a status flag from that call is set and the returned low byte exceeds a global limit, applies the record's pending value to three global counters. It then calls a function pointer from a table in every case.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0000
name: replace_state_and_notify_previous
description: Stores a new word in the object's state field. When the previous value was nonzero, it also calls a function pointer from the table entry selected by that old value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0014
name: store_state_word
description: Stores the input word into a state field of the structure and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:001A
name: lookup_table_by_magnitude_range
description: Maps a 32-bit input to an index in a large table by shifting it according to one of several magnitude ranges. It then returns the 16-bit table value scaled by a range-dependent shift.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0390
name: initialize_entity_table
description: Writes fixed constants and handler pointers into a table block, then walks its eight-byte slots. For each slot it copies the first longword of the structure it points to into a parallel field and calls the function pointer stored in that structure's second longword.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0464
name: initialize_and_iterate_table
description: Initializes several global state fields and, when the input is below a limit, seeds two constant state longwords. It then repeats a pass over the table, calling a function pointer in each entry, until a counter reaches a fixed bound.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:04CC
name: dispatch_periodic_updates
description: Clears several status bits, then calls a per-entry method for flagged entries. When an accumulated time difference spans a full fixed period, it divides out the whole periods, calls another method on flagged entries with that count, and walks a flagged byte table backward.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0548
name: call_handler_if_active
description: Walks the table of entries and calls the method at a fixed offset for each entry whose flag byte is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:056A
name: fetch_code_and_dispatch_match
description: When bit zero of a global flag byte is clear, it calls an unnamed routine that returns a code value. The scan that would match that code against table entries and call the matched entry's method sits behind a condition that the decompiled code never satisfies on that path.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:05A2
name: call_handler_by_bit_mask
description: Chooses a bit position from an input code using four specific codes, then calls the method at a fixed offset for every table entry whose flag byte has that bit set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:05EE
name: update_pseudo_random_state
description: Updates two 32-bit state longwords by XORing one with a constant, rotating it, and adding the result to the first. It replaces the second with a rotated copy of the old first and writes both back to the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:060A
name: compute_scaled_random_value
description: Advances the two 32-bit state longwords with a rotate-and-add step, then multiplies the input's low word by the high word of the new state. It returns the product folded into a 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:062C
name: scale_input_by_state
description: Multiplies the low word of the input by the high word of a sum built from a rotated register value, that same register value, and a second input. It returns the folded 32-bit product.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:063C
name: negate_64_bit_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine for a 64-bit value and returns its two's complement negation, carrying from the high word into the low word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0648
name: subtract_and_scale_64_bit
description: Subtracts one 64-bit value from another and, when the difference is nonnegative, multiplies its words by a 32-bit factor using partial products and returns the shifted product. When the difference is negative, it calls an unnamed routine and returns the negation of its 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:064E
name: perform_32x32_multiplication
description: Multiplies two 32-bit operands using 16-bit partial products and carry propagation, returning a 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:06AE
name: compute_interpolated_offset_pairs
description: Samples two values from an unnamed routine at an index derived from the high word of a register, stores their differences with a zero, and multiplies those differences by a weight to form six longwords. It writes the longwords into three pairs, shifting the products left or right by a count derived from the input.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:072E
name: store_direct_and_shifted_pairs
description: Writes three longwords directly into the first half of three 64-bit pairs. It then writes three values shifted left by one less than a supplied count into the matching high halves.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0738
name: accumulate_scaled_vector
description: Scales three signed 16-bit components by a factor from the structure, shifts each product right by a count derived from a stored field, and adds the results into three 64-bit accumulator pairs with carries.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0796
name: normalize_and_double_result
description: Counts how many right shifts reduce a register value to zero, calls an unnamed routine for a 64-bit value, and doubles that value left by the counted number of places.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:07BE
name: scale_down_then_double_result
description: Shifts a 32-bit input right until it fits within 15 bits, calls an unnamed routine for a 64-bit value, and doubles that value left by the same number of places.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:07D2
name: negate_64bit_halves
description: Calls an unnamed routine for a 64-bit value and returns the negation of each 32-bit half separately, without carrying between them.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:07E6
name: normalize_multiply_and_double
description: Handles three cases: a negative input returns the negated result of an unnamed routine, while a zero input multiplies a 32-bit pair by a shifted value and returns the product when that value fits within 15 bits. Other inputs count shifts and call an unnamed routine, and the counted results are doubled by the counted places.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:07EA
name: normalize_multiply_on_flag
description: Uses a status flag to choose a path: the flagged path multiplies a 32-bit pair by a shifted input and returns that product when the shifted value fits within 15 bits, and otherwise counts shifts. The other path counts shifts from a register value, and both shift-counted paths call an unnamed routine and double its result by the counted places.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:07EC
name: multiply_pair_by_shifted_input
description: Shifts a 32-bit input right by seven places and, when that value fits within 15 bits, multiplies a 32-bit pair by it and returns the 64-bit product. Otherwise it reduces the value further, calls an unnamed routine, and doubles that result by the counted places.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:07F6
name: multiply_two_longs_by_word
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values by a 16-bit factor using partial products and carries, then shifts each 64-bit product right by one place. The two results are returned as a 64-bit pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0854
name: add_result_to_accumulators
description: Adds the 64-bit value returned by an unnamed routine into the low words of three accumulator pairs, with carries into the high words. Stored offsets and a register input are added into those high words as well.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0882
name: invoke_two_sequential_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:08A8
name: invoke_two_sequential_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:08CE
name: invoke_two_sequential_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:08F4
name: fetch_table_entry
description: Returns the 16-bit value at a byte offset from a global table base pointer, using the input register as the offset.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0906
name: store_table_base_pointers
description: Stores two supplied longword values into global pointer slots used by the table lookups.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0910
name: point_table_slots_at_globals
description: Points two global table slots at the same global data block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0922
name: claim_free_slot_with_counter
description: If a byte slot in the table is zero and a global counter is below a limit, it records the counter in that slot, stores the slot index with the counter in a word pair, and advances the counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:093C
name: store_indexed_byte_and_advance
description: When a global counter is below a limit, writes a byte into the second structure at the supplied index, stores the index with the counter in a word pair, and advances the counter by four. Otherwise it returns zero for that half.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:094E
name: write_byte_and_index
description: Writes the low byte of one input at an offset in a buffer, stores both inputs as a word pair in a second array, and advances a stored offset word by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0962
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work, so it is an empty stub.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:096E
name: check_point_pairs_then_call
description: Checks two coordinate pairs against fixed upper limits; when a pair exceeds them it converts it through an unnamed routine and returns if the converted value is still out of range. When both pairs pass, it calls another unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0986
name: forward_control_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to an unnamed routine and returns, forwarding nothing else.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0996
name: check_point_bounds_and_forward
description: Checks two coordinate pairs against fixed upper limits, converting out-of-range pairs through an unnamed routine. When both pairs pass, it calls another unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:09AA
name: check_single_point_then_call
description: Passes one coordinate pair through an unnamed routine and returns if either value exceeds a fixed upper limit. Otherwise it calls another unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:09C2
name: set_entry_flags_when_flagged
description: When a record flag bit is set, sets two global status bits, writes the value two to a record byte, sets one record status bit and clears another, then calls an unnamed routine. A second record flag bit triggers the same update without the first global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:09D4
name: set_flags_and_call
description: Sets two global status bits, writes the value two to a record byte, sets one record status bit and clears another, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0A06
name: set_flag_and_call
description: Sets one global status bit, writes the value two to a record byte, sets and clears record status bits, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0A32
name: clear_bit_and_advance_counter
description: If a record flag bit is set, clears it and advances a counter by four: a global counter when a record byte equals minus one, otherwise a record word. It then sets a record byte to seven and updates status bits, calls two unnamed routines, and sets a global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0A3E
name: store_flags_and_advance_counter
description: Stores a supplied longword into a record flag field, advances a counter by four, sets a record byte to seven, and updates status bits. It then calls two unnamed routines and sets a status bit in the global flag byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0A50
name: set_object_state_and_flags
description: Advances a record counter word by four, sets a record byte to seven, and updates two record status bits. It then calls two unnamed routines and sets a status bit in the global flag byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0A8E
name: call_if_record_type_small
description: When a record's type field is below a fixed limit and differs from the second record, it calls an unnamed routine and then, if the supplied value is below a fixed threshold, calls another unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0ABC
name: update_record_from_table_selection
description: Selects a pair of table values by the record's type code, sets status bits and an accumulator word from their product, and calls unnamed routines. When the update is not cancelled, it adds a table-scaled amount to a saturating 16-bit field and returns the scaled result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:6:0C12
